write_and_read_faiss_index: write a faiss index to disk with faiss.write_index and read it back with faiss.read_index
serialize_and_deserialize_faiss_index: serialize a faiss index to bytes with faiss.serialize_index and restore it with faiss.deserialize_index
pickle_faiss_index: pickle a faiss index to a BytesIO buffer and load it back with pickle.dump and pickle.load
write_and_read_vector_transform: write a faiss VectorTransform to a file with faiss.write_VectorTransform and read it back with faiss.read_VectorTransform
write_and_read_product_quantizer: write a faiss ProductQuantizer to disk with faiss.write_ProductQuantizer and read it back with faiss.read_ProductQuantizer
